ruledOut: Treat the 8-case fixture census as the fallback population: all 8 fixture cases hit and contribute no fallback rows.
Treat loose 0 of 24 as a property of the rule alone: the corpus avoids the exact tokens by construction.
Treat p_win=0.00001526 as an error probability: it is a sign-test tail over manufactured discordance.
Treat the three-order protocol as free accuracy on this population: F=0 with unanimous picks.
Treat a regex widening as measurable on the current corpus: it avoids every verdict token.
Treat the printed token estimate as measured cost: it is a pre-run character heuristic.
Treat 24 of 24 as establishing a usable precision level: the one-sided 95 percent lower bound is 88.3 percent.
Treat the two zero-call baselines as realistic competitors: both sit at their floor by construction.
Treat the labels as independent ground truth: they equal the author intent with no per-row decisions record.
Treating already-measured 047 features as transfer answers: their verdicts show where the judgment was tested, not where the shape remains available.
Replacing the artifact-based completion check with a model read: self-report unreliability is why the artifact check exists.
Flipping the grader default on today corpus: the fallback is inert there and the only miss population is synthetic.
Treating the version pin as drift protection by itself: it needs a stored report to compare against.
Treating the payload question as settled by --accept-payload: a live policy needs an explicit decision.
